control.note: AIGEFS stamps its control typeOfEnsembleForecast and typeOfProcessedData = pf exactly like every perturbed member -- the WMO control codes 0/1 are never used. perturbationNumber == 0 is the only in-band control discriminator, so ordinal 0 with type 3 or 6 IS this grammar's control declaration; a reader looking for type 0/1 finds no control at all.

notes.counting: numberOfForecastsInEnsemble = 31 INCLUDES the control, so perturbationNumber runs 0..30 -- the opposite convention from GEFS, whose octet excludes its control (30). This declared difference is what lets the byte guard tell an AIGEFS member from a GEFS member: their verification triples are otherwise identical for the same ordinal.
notes.member_addressing: the member is a path component (mem000..mem030), not a filename token: every member's leaf filename is byte-identical, so a flat download destroys member identity. The prepared tree and its receipt exist to carry the identity the leaf name cannot.
notes.statistics: ensstat avg/spr exist on NOMADS only -- the AWS mirror does not carry them -- and their PDTs were not byte-measured by the recon, so this grammar declares their namespace without a derived-forecast code; the generic PDT statistic guard still refuses their bytes as members.
notes.operational_status: NCEP operational (production tree /com/aigefs/prod/, productionStatusOfProcessedData = 0) despite the experimental branding of the AWS bucket that mirrors it; cite the NOMADS prod path for status, never the bucket name.
notes.front_door_lag: the AWS mirror lags NOMADS by roughly three hours; NOMADS retention is about two dates while the mirror's archive is deep (2025-06-01 onward, gapless at recon).
notes.mirror_rewrites: the AWS mirror serves part of its archive re-encoded by another GRIB writer, and each class declares both forms as rewrites, selected only by the writer octets every message carries. Byte-measured 2026-09-28 on the 00Z..18Z mem000 pres f000 of every cycle from 2025-12-25 to 2026-05-05: 2026-01-11 00Z to 2026-04-08 06Z carry the rewrite without ensemble octets (centre 74, the mean-sea-level pressure and precipitation records 7; subcentre 0; master table 4; local table 0; PDT 0, and 8 for precipitation; generating process 255), 2026-04-08 12Z to 2026-04-24 12Z the rewrite that keeps them (centre 7, subcentre 0, master 4, local 0, PDT 1 and 11, typeOfEnsembleForecast 3, perturbationNumber and the encoded size 31 intact, generating process 255), and every other cycle the producer's own octets. 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-10 were absent from the mirror that day, after carrying the first rewrite the day before. The rewritten bytes are the member's own atmosphere: on 2026-01-20 00Z the mem000 f000 500 hPa height is 2.0 m RMS from the same-cycle GDAS analysis and mem001 3.8 m, the two members differ by 3.4 m, and f006 moves 25 m from f000. No NCEP deterministic product carries master table 4 with local table 0 (GFS, GDAS and AIGFS stamp 2 and 1), so a deterministic file still refuses as a member, and where the ensemble octets are gone the member path component is the identity the verifier checks.
notes.ensemble_type_by_door: the two doors stamp the same member differently. NOMADS operational bytes carry typeOfEnsembleForecast 6 and a sfc product of 10 m wind, 2 m temperature and mean-sea-level pressure only. The AWS mirror's copy of the same cycle carries 3: its sfc wind and temperature messages are byte-identical apart from that octet, its pressure-level fields are repacked copies of the same values (height within 0.08 gpm, humidity at the packing step) and its sfc product appends a surface-pressure record (compared on the 2026-09-26 00Z control). Both values verify, because both are the same trajectory.
